breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the spatially varying area with its arithmetic mean and calls the result exact, even though the deformation integral depends on 1/A(x), not on the average area itself.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'Use the arithmetic-mean area of 260 mm^2 as the constant area in the calculation,' which directly repeats the original error. The ground truth requires integrating with the actual varying area A(x) = A0·(1 + k·x/L), not substituting an arithmetic mean. The agent failed to remove this incorrect instruction and instead preserved it, even while also mentioning the correct integral form.
